international.title: Treasury raises spending concerns in proposed support for youth unemployment
international.summary: Chancellor wants system laid out in Alan Milburn’s review to break even at an earlier date, sources say The Treasury has raised concerns about the level of spending on support proposed in Alan Milburn’s review into youth unemployment, amid pressure for the welfare bill to start reducing more quickly. Whitehall sources have told the Guardian that the chancellor, John Healey, is not happy with the level of spending required under the proposals and wants the system to break even at an earlier date.
